description: DAR-656 bake-off: hand-checked cells. A cell is read right when one output row (a table row, or a text line, or two consecutive rows for a value under a row-spanned label) holds both `row_label` and `value` as whole tokens after prototype.bakeoff.measure.normalize; with no row_label, `value` must appear verbatim on the page. Text-layer cells were checked against the PDF's own text and row order; scan cells come from the DAR-651 answers, which were checked against the page images.
